notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (customer-support/chat) product team evaluating Redwood Hosted API as primary fast path; Dedicated considered after POC for predictable throughput.

Recent activity / timeline:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (Jordan + Priya) — product requirements + high-level pricing. customer wants streaming and tool-calling (ticket lookup, KB search).
- 2026-02-25: Technical deep-dive (ff_2026-02-25_98123). SE demoed streaming + function-calls; customer requested first-token latency numbers.

Use-case & requirements (from product/engineering):
- Primary workload: customer support chat agents (multi-turn), human handoff, agent-assist suggestions.
- Key features: streaming responses (progressive UI), tool/function calling (ticket search, account lookup, KB retrieval), structured outputs for ticket creation.
- Latency SLO: target first-token <1.5s p95 for typical EU/NA users; sub-600ms for cached prefix hits.
- Throughput: peak 150 concurrent chat sessions per region; burst to 400 for promos. autoscaling required.
- Model preferences: open-ish foundation models ok; prefer model variants with verified streaming perf and quantized options. fallback routing desired (cheaper variant when overloaded).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budgets; cost per 1M tokens => needs comparison vs. Dedicated commit.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO/SAML for agent UI.
- Audit logs and token-level tracing required for 90-day retention (longer for EMEA customers).
- KMS integration asked (customer uses AWS KMS).
- Data residency: initial scope NA/EU; legal may require EU-only for subset of customers — potential blocker for Hosted unless EU region guaranteed.

POC plan (agreed):
1) 2-week Hosted API POC (March 16–30): integrate streaming endpoint into their Angular agent UI; enable function-calling for KB/ticket lookup via connector.
2) Run synthetic load tests + real traffic shadowing for latency profile; capture first-token p50/p95/p99.
3) Redwood to provide recommended batching/cache settings and quantization notes for cost reduction.
4) Outcome: acceptance if first-token p95 <1.5s and tool-calling reliability >98% under normal load.

Customer quotes / signals:
- "Streaming is non-negotiable — agents need incremental tokens to triage fast." — Head of Product (A. Moreno)
- "If we can get predictable latency and cheaper per-token economics we will consider Dedicated for peak hours." — VP Eng (S. Patel)

- Estimated ARR range provided above; procurement timeline targeted for 2026-04 if POC successful.
